draft.briefing: Hey, you're in Malpe! This fishing port at the mouth of the Malpe River is so old that the Greek geographer Ptolemy mentioned it back in the second century.
draft.hungryLine: Malpe is the biggest fishing harbour in Udupi district, so fresh fish is the thing to eat here.

moodReplies.show-me-around: The Malpe Seawalk is a 15 minute walk, and the ferry to St. Mary's Island is about 14 minutes away.
moodReplies.somewhere-to-chill: Walk out on the Sea Walkway at Malpe Beach and look across to St. Mary's Island and Bhadargad Island.
moodReplies.surprise-me: Malpe even shows up in an ancient Greek farce, written on papyri from the second century or earlier.

spots.name: Ferry St. Mary's Island
spots.detail: 14 min walk · Boats out to St. Mary's Island

spots.name: Malpe Seawalk
spots.detail: 15 min walk · Sea views of the islands

tips.title: Watch out for the monsoon.
tips.body: This stretch of coast gets heavy rain from June to October.

tips.title: Walk the Sea Walkway.
tips.body: It gives you a view of St. Mary's Island, Bhadargad Island and the coastline.

story.title: Ptolemy's port
story.body: The Greek geographer Ptolemy mentioned Malpe, an ancient port where Karnataka traded with the western world.

story.title: In a Greek play
story.body: An old Greek farce on papyri, later published in The Oxyrhynchus Papyri Part III, also mentions the place.

story.title: A fishing town
story.body: Malpe is the largest fishing harbour in Udupi district, and many people here work in the fishing industry. It's home to the Mogaveera fishing community.
